creator: Alexander Terp
description:
When herdr makes a split but its answer is lost, the new pane is listed under a different Muster name from the one in its own `$MUSTER_PANE`. An agent in that pane then gets "no pane called ..." from `muster pane new`.

Since `5a5abb4` a timed-out split is `Refusal::Unanswered` rather than a refusal, but `HerdrBackend::submit` still releases the name it minted: the name can only be bound to the backend id the lost answer carried. The pane then arrives on events and is minted a fresh name, while the process inside it was started with the first one.

Found by slot 2 of the 2026-09-12 round. Not seen in the app; read from the code.
title: A split whose answer was lost lists its pane under another name
